provenance.authoritative_column: THE TABLE COLUMN, NEVER THE PROSE BESIDE IT. terminology-ko.md section 11.4 measured this against card-text-ko.json on 2026-08-18: sections 2.3 and 8's PROSE disagrees with 2.3's own Korean COLUMN on nine terms (Relic, Terror, Hazard, Servitor, Allied, Dreamlands, Abomination, Wayfarer, Rival) and the shipped cards follow the column every time. The reviewer edited the column and left the justification standing. This import therefore takes the column and records the section it came from; the nine stale prose renderings are banned outright by guide/translate-guide.py (BANNED, exit 23).
provenance.precedence: card-text-ko.json > this file's table column > glossary.json
provenance.verdict_mapping: The sheet's own source vocabulary is wider than the tool's three verdicts (data/terms/README.md): glossary -> glossary; coined -> coined; and rules-ref / faq / precedent / official Korean print / shipped card all -> rules_ref, i.e. 'an external authority carries it and it is not the glossary'. The sheet's literal token is preserved verbatim in each entry's `note`, so the widening is recorded rather than lost. `precedent` rows carry confidence `medium` -- the sheet grades them 'light review' -- and every other row is `high`.

Select Difficulty.rationale: Not a card trait — tile/UI text. Zero occurrences in the 62 cards' traits field, so Count carries no corpus value here; the string is printed on the difficulty-select tile image (tile/a870c1-ko.png). Coined by the korean-difficulty-tile task and recorded in tile/manifest.json (string block); composed from 난이도 (§5.1, source glossary) + 선택, the noun + 선택 order the mod's own Korean UI uses (SCED/src/Global/i18nData.ttslua, 11 occurrences). That task recorded no alternates. Filed here because §2.3 is this file's coinage review surface. Confirmed 2026-08-17 by shanash. Note the string is currently printed nowhere: the difficulty tile was dropped on 2026-08-17 (option (a) — the English tile ships, because the langpack override engine matches on GMNotes.id and base difficulty selectors have none), and the R2 object was deleted. The entry is kept because the coinage is sound and tile/ still holds the accepted PNGs, so it applies as-is if base data ever gains ids.
